verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. repairHistoryDifference is 𝔪_f - 𝔪_N row by row: the five cumulative integrals, up to radius X, of the change in density caused by the correction. repairHistory_scalar_jets is the display with j ≤ q in place of j ≤ 2 and with the small factor written as K·eps rather than C/N. The rewriting: take q = 2, S = [-1,1], and eps = C/N from exists_actual_restoring_repair; the side condition eps ≤ delta is the paper's own "increasing N if necessary". The Lean quantifies over all X ∈ ℝ with the integral clamped to the patch window [P.left, P.right], which covers the paper's X ∈ [Y_0,Y_1] and in addition gives the value beyond Y_1. The Lean hypothesis FiniteJetBound q c S eps on the coefficients corresponds to the paper's ‖c‖_{C²} ≤ 2ν₂D₂/N from the previous display.
